cards.name: The HODLR
cards.subtitle: Diamond Hands Eternal

abilities.name: Seal the Vault
abilities.text: Locks every holding for a full cycle. Nothing enters, nothing leaves.

abilities.name: Unmoved
abilities.text: Ignores all price signals, forecasts and pleading.

abilities.name: Outlast the Cycle
abilities.text: Once per era, survives a collapse that erases everyone else.

cards.weakness: Opportunity. He will miss all of it.
cards.lore: He bought once, at a price nobody remembers, and never spoke of it again. Winters came, the throne grew frost, and the coffer stayed shut. Everyone who begged him to sell is gone. He is still sitting.

traits.label: Cold Storage
traits.text: Keys buried where no market can reach them.

traits.label: Frostbound
traits.text: Panic passes over him like weather.

traits.label: Long Memory
traits.text: Remembers every cycle that swore it was different.

traits.label: Sealed Coffer
traits.text: What is inside has never been counted aloud.

cards.flavor: Time is the only indicator he trusts.

cards.name: The SEC Punisher
cards.subtitle: Enforcement Incarnate

abilities.name: Serve Notice
abilities.text: Freezes a target's operations until the paperwork is answered.

abilities.name: Jurisdiction
abilities.text: No venue is beyond reach. None.

abilities.name: Retroactive Ruling
abilities.text: Once per cycle, rewrites what was permitted yesterday.

cards.weakness: Speed. The letter always arrives late.
cards.lore: He does not chase. He files. Somewhere a founder is on a lit stage promising the future, and somewhere else a clerk is stamping the date that ends it. The gavel is bronze, the ink is permanent, and the calendar belongs to him.

traits.label: Subpoena
traits.text: Questions that cost more than their answers.

traits.label: Annotated Ledger
traits.text: Every wallet, footnoted twice.

traits.label: Slow Gavel
traits.text: Arrives years after the party ends.

traits.label: No Exemptions
traits.text: Titles and offshore charters mean nothing here.

cards.flavor: You were compliant. Yesterday.

cards.name: The Whale
cards.subtitle: Market Mover

abilities.name: Breach
abilities.text: Surfaces one order large enough to move the entire book.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.text: Every smaller position drifts toward its wake.

abilities.name: Sound the Depths
abilities.text: Once per cycle, empties a market and refills it at its own price.

cards.weakness: Cannot move quietly. The water always tells.
cards.lore: It does not trade so much as displace. Fleets of smaller vessels read the swell, call it a forecast, then name the wreckage a correction. The creature has no opinion on price. It simply needed room.

traits.label: Deep Ballast
traits.text: Holdings measured in fathoms, not figures.

traits.label: Slow Turn
traits.text: Changes direction over months.

traits.label: Wake Reader
traits.text: Others navigate by what it leaves behind.

traits.label: Unbothered
traits.text: Feels no drawdown it did not choose.

cards.flavor: The chart was a shadow it cast.

cards.name: The Rug Puller
cards.subtitle: Liquidity Thief

abilities.name: Open the Floor
abilities.text: Removes the ground beneath every holder at once.

abilities.name: Warm Welcome
abilities.text: New arrivals trust him on sight.

abilities.name: Fresh Name
abilities.text: Once per cycle, returns as someone entirely new.

cards.weakness: Memory. Someone always kept the screenshots.
cards.lore: The hall was gilded, the promises were specific, and the door behind the podium was unmarked. By the time the room understood the floor was a curtain, the curtain was in his hand. He is three cities away, printing new invitations.

traits.label: Gilded Tongue
traits.text: Every guarantee sounds structural.

traits.label: Trapdoor Craft
traits.text: Builds the exit before the foundation.

traits.label: No Fingerprints
traits.text: Signs nothing he cannot disown.

traits.label: Serial Founder
traits.text: The last collapse is always someone else's.

cards.flavor: Thank you all for the early support.

cards.name: The Maxi
cards.subtitle: One Coin to Rule Them All

abilities.name: Denounce
abilities.text: Declares every rival asset worthless, at volume.

abilities.name: Immune to Doubt
abilities.text: Counterevidence strengthens the position.

abilities.name: Orthodoxy
abilities.text: Once per cycle, converts a wavering crowd entirely.

cards.weakness: Everything outside the one true chain.
cards.lore: He arrived early, understood one thing completely, and decided that was sufficient. The sermon has not changed in a decade, which he offers as proof. Half the hall has stopped listening. The other half has started taking notes.

traits.label: Single Creed
traits.text: One ledger, held as scripture.

traits.label: Sermon Ready
traits.text: No gathering is too small to address.

traits.label: Long Winter
traits.text: Fed on cold years that broke the others.

traits.label: No Hedge
traits.text: Diversification is treated as apostasy.

cards.flavor: There is one ledger. The rest is noise.

cards.name: The Satoshi
cards.subtitle: The Vanished Founder

abilities.name: Lay the Stone
abilities.text: Builds a system that no longer requires its builder.

abilities.name: Absent
abilities.text: Cannot be found, subpoenaed, bribed or interviewed.

abilities.name: Walk Away
abilities.text: Once per era, abandons a fortune to protect the thing built.

cards.weakness: Nothing. That is the entire problem.
cards.lore: The work was finished, the door was closed quietly, and the hall has spent every year since arguing about who was in the room. A fortune sits untouched under a name nobody can prove. The greatest thing built here was the decision to leave.

traits.label: No Face
traits.text: Every portrait of them is a guess.

traits.label: Untouched Hoard
traits.text: A fortune that has never moved.

traits.label: Clean Exit
traits.text: Left before the worship began.

traits.label: Still Running
traits.text: The work continues without its author.

cards.flavor: The last thing built was the exit.

cards.name: The Miner
cards.subtitle: Guardian of Proof

abilities.name: Stoke the Forge
abilities.text: Converts raw power into ledger weight, hour after hour.

abilities.name: Always Running
abilities.text: Does not stop for weather, price or opinion.

abilities.name: Difficulty Adjustment
abilities.text: Once per cycle, the work gets harder and he keeps going.

cards.weakness: The power bill. Always the power bill.
cards.lore: The hall is loud, hot, and lit entirely by machines that never sleep. He does not speculate; he converts. Every coin in this set passed through a room like this one, and somebody paid for the heat.

traits.label: Furnace Tender
traits.text: Measures wealth in kilowatts.

traits.label: Half Deaf
traits.text: Years beside the fans cost him the high notes.

traits.label: Thin Margin
traits.text: Profitable only while the price cooperates.

traits.label: Never Idle
traits.text: A stopped machine is a loss, not a rest.

cards.flavor: Every coin was somebody's electricity.

cards.name: The Cold Wallet
cards.subtitle: Keeper of the Keys

abilities.name: Seal
abilities.text: Places holdings beyond the reach of any network.

abilities.name: Air Gap
abilities.text: Nothing connected can touch what is inside.

abilities.name: Forgotten Door
abilities.text: Once per era, protects a fortune so well nobody can open it.

cards.weakness: It protects against you as thoroughly as against them.
cards.lore: It has no ports, no signal and no opinion. Whatever is placed inside is safe from every thief in the world and from its owner in equal measure. Half the great fortunes of the age are sealed in rooms like this one, waiting for a memory that never returns.

traits.label: Air Gapped
traits.text: No wire has ever touched it.

traits.label: Panic Deaf
traits.text: Cannot be opened in a hurry.

traits.label: Two Locks
traits.text: One for the thief, one for the owner.

traits.label: Patient
traits.text: Content to hold for a hundred years.

cards.flavor: Safe from everyone. Including you.

cards.name: The Lost Keys
cards.subtitle: Fortune Forever Sealed

abilities.name: Seal Forever
abilities.text: Removes a fortune from circulation. No appeal, no recovery, no exceptions.

abilities.name: Silent Deflation
abilities.text: Every coin it holds makes every other coin scarcer.

abilities.name: Two Guesses Left
abilities.text: Permits one final attempt at the password. The whole market holds its breath.

cards.weakness: A scrap of paper in an old coat pocket.
cards.lore: Somewhere a hard drive spins down for the last time, holding more wealth than a small nation. Its owner remembers the morning he earned it, but not the twelve words. The fortune is perfectly safe now. Safe from everyone.

traits.label: Iron Patience
traits.text: Will outwait every market and every heir.

traits.label: Dead Weight
traits.text: Wealth that can never move again.

traits.label: Quiet Gift
traits.text: Its loss enriches everyone else.

traits.label: Landfill Legend
traits.text: Buried under a hill somewhere, allegedly.

cards.flavor: The richest wallets never spend.

cards.name: The Bull
cards.subtitle: Bringer of Green Candles

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: Doubles everything in the hall and asks no permission.

abilities.name: Contagion
abilities.text: Every witness becomes a believer, then a buyer.

abilities.name: Blow-Off Top
abilities.text: Once per cycle, runs so hard it breaks its own legs.

cards.weakness: Stamina. It always outruns its own supply.
cards.lore: It arrives without warning and everyone who doubted it becomes a convert by the second week. Fortunes are made by people who mistake the animal for their own judgement. It does not stop when the ground ends; it simply keeps running.

traits.label: No Brakes
traits.text: Deceleration is not in the anatomy.

traits.label: Makes Geniuses
traits.text: Everyone is brilliant while it runs.

traits.label: Short Lived
traits.text: Burns the whole season in a month.

traits.label: Leaves Debt
traits.text: The bill arrives after it has gone.

cards.flavor: Everyone is a genius while it runs.

cards.name: The Bear
cards.subtitle: Destroyer of Euphoria

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.text: Takes a third of everything and calls it a warning.

abilities.name: Long Sleep
abilities.text: Absent for years, then suddenly not.

abilities.name: Capitulation
abilities.text: Once per cycle, empties the hall of everyone who arrived late.

cards.weakness: Cannot last forever. Nothing eats forever.
cards.lore: It does not hunt the reckless first. It hunts the patient, the leveraged and the certain, in that order, and takes its time. When the hall is finally empty it lies down in the wreckage and sleeps, and the survivors call that a bottom.

traits.label: Slow Jaw
traits.text: Kills by duration, not by force.

traits.label: Herd Thinner
traits.text: Leaves only those who never needed the money.

traits.label: No Season
traits.text: Arrives whenever conviction is highest.

traits.label: Honest
traits.text: Never promised anyone anything.

cards.flavor: It eats the certain first.

cards.name: The Black Swan
cards.subtitle: The Unseen Catastrophe

abilities.name: Land Unseen
abilities.text: Arrives from the one direction nobody hedged.

abilities.name: Off the Charts
abilities.text: No model contains it. That is the definition.

abilities.name: Rewrite History
abilities.text: After it passes, everyone claims they saw it coming.

cards.weakness: Hindsight. Everyone was about to predict it.
cards.lore: The analysts mapped every risk except the one that mattered. It did not announce itself; it simply arrived, and the old world ended between two candles. Afterward the survivors wrote books about the warning signs. There were none.

traits.label: No Warning
traits.text: The first signal is the impact.

traits.label: Model Breaker
traits.text: Lives outside every backtest.

traits.label: Great Equalizer
traits.text: Leverage dies first when it lands.

traits.label: Rare Bird
traits.text: Seen once a decade, felt forever.

cards.flavor: Nobody hedges the impossible.

cards.name: The Death Candle
cards.subtitle: One Wick to Ruin Them All

cards.name: The Market Maker
cards.subtitle: Keeper of the Spread

abilities.name: Quote Both Sides
abilities.text: Offers to buy and sell the same thing, simultaneously.

abilities.name: Always Filled
abilities.text: Every order finds him, whichever way it leans.

abilities.name: Widen the Spread
abilities.text: Once per cycle, makes the exit cost whatever he decides.

cards.weakness: A market with only one direction left.
cards.lore: He holds no view on where price is going, which is why he is still here. Every trade in the hall passes through his hands and leaves a thin film behind. Nobody thanks him. Nobody could function without him.

traits.label: Two Faces
traits.text: Buys and sells the same breath.

traits.label: Thin Margin
traits.text: Earns almost nothing, ten thousand times.

traits.label: No Opinion
traits.text: Direction is somebody else's problem.

traits.label: First Gone
traits.text: Withdraws the moment the floor tilts.

cards.flavor: Someone has to stand between the two of you.

cards.name: The Halving
cards.subtitle: The Supply Reckoning

abilities.name: Narrow the Flow
abilities.text: Cuts new supply in half. No vote, no appeal.

abilities.name: Scheduled
abilities.text: Arrives on time, every time, forever.

abilities.name: Squeeze the Forge
abilities.text: Once per era, ends every operation running on thin margin.

cards.weakness: Priced in. Allegedly.
cards.lore: It is not an event so much as an appointment, written before anyone in this hall was born. The faucet narrows by exactly half, the weakest forges go cold, and the survivors inherit the heat. Everyone insists they saw it coming, and everyone is surprised anyway.

traits.label: On Schedule
traits.text: Announced decades in advance.

traits.label: Half
traits.text: Precisely half. Never a fraction more.

traits.label: Forge Cull
traits.text: The inefficient go dark that week.

traits.label: Priced In
traits.text: Everyone says so. Nobody acts like it.

cards.flavor: Written before any of you arrived.

cards.name: The Genesis Block
cards.subtitle: Where It All Began

abilities.name: Anchor
abilities.text: Every block since traces its lineage here.

abilities.name: Unspendable
abilities.text: Its contents can never be moved. By design.

abilities.name: First Light
abilities.text: Once per era, reminds the hall that all of this began with nothing.

cards.weakness: It cannot be used. Only revered.
cards.lore: It is the one stone laid before there was a wall, holding a message that has outlived every hand that read it. Nothing in it can ever be spent, which is precisely why it is priceless. Every ledger in existence is an argument that starts here.

traits.label: Cornerstone
traits.text: Everything after descends from it.

traits.label: Locked Forever
traits.text: Its coins were never spendable.

traits.label: Inscribed
traits.text: Carries a message about a failing world.

traits.label: Unowned
traits.text: Belongs to no one and to the whole hall.

cards.flavor: It begins with nothing and holds everything.

cards.name: The Crypto Winter
cards.subtitle: The Long Freeze

abilities.name: Freeze the Feed
abilities.text: Halts the hype mid-sentence. Timelines go quiet for years.

abilities.name: Test of Conviction
abilities.text: Only builders and believers survive the season.

abilities.name: The Thaw
abilities.text: Ends without announcement. The patient wake up wealthy.

cards.weakness: Spring. It has never once failed to arrive.
cards.lore: The music stops slowly, then all at once, and the tourists leave with the weather. What remains is quiet: builders committing code into the dark, believers averaging in unseen. The winter does not hate anyone. It is simply sorting them.

traits.label: Long Season
traits.text: Measured in years, not candles.

traits.label: Great Filter
traits.text: Removes everything built on hype.

traits.label: Quiet Forge
traits.text: The next cycle is built here.

traits.label: Cold Math
traits.text: Prices return to what is real.

cards.flavor: Winter doesn't kill projects. It reveals them.

cards.name: The Oracle
cards.subtitle: Voice of the Outside World

abilities.name: Report the Price
abilities.text: Declares one number, and the ledger accepts it as fact.

abilities.name: Single Source
abilities.text: Everything downstream depends on being believed.

abilities.name: Bad Feed
abilities.text: Once per cycle, one wrong number liquidates a kingdom.

cards.weakness: Nobody checks the seer until the seer is wrong.
cards.lore: The chain cannot see outside itself, so it appointed someone to look. She reports the weather of the world in a single figure and the machinery obeys without asking how she knows. The whole structure rests on her not lying, and on her not being lied to.

traits.label: One Number
traits.text: The world, compressed to a single figure.

traits.label: Blind Trust
traits.text: Believed instantly, verified rarely.

traits.label: Chokepoint
traits.text: Everything downstream inherits her mistakes.

traits.label: Quiet Power
traits.text: Rules a market she never trades in.

cards.flavor: The chain believes whatever it is told.

cards.name: The Blockchain
cards.subtitle: The Immutable Chronicle

abilities.name: Append Only
abilities.text: Writes the next block. What is written cannot be unwritten.

abilities.name: Perfect Witness
abilities.text: Remembers every transaction ever made, forever, for everyone.

abilities.name: Consensus
abilities.text: Thousands of strangers agree on one truth without ever meeting.

cards.weakness: It remembers your mistakes too.
cards.lore: Every fortune, every folly, every midnight mistake — written in a book that cannot be edited and never closes. Kings and thieves alike get one line each. The chronicle does not judge. It only records.

traits.label: Immutable
traits.text: History without an eraser.

traits.label: Public Record
traits.text: Everyone may read every page.

traits.label: Trustless
traits.text: Needs no one's permission or honesty.

traits.label: Eternal
traits.text: Outlives every author who writes in it.

cards.flavor: The chain remembers what everyone forgets.

cards.name: The Bitcoin
cards.subtitle: Digital Gold

abilities.name: Store of Value
abilities.text: Absorbs the wealth of every fallen empire of the cycle.

abilities.name: Twenty-One Million
abilities.text: The supply never bends. Not for anyone.

abilities.name: Genesis Memory
abilities.text: Once per era, reminds the world why it exists.

cards.weakness: Its own children, moving faster than it ever will.
cards.lore: It was born in a financial crisis with a newspaper headline for a birth certificate. Everything since — every fork, every rival, every obituary — has orbited it. It does not innovate. It endures.

traits.label: First Mover
traits.text: Every chart begins with it.

traits.label: Hard Cap
traits.text: Twenty-one million, and not one more.

traits.label: Obituary Proof
traits.text: Declared dead hundreds of times, still here.

traits.label: Slow King
traits.text: Moves last, arrives anyway.

cards.flavor: Everything else is an experiment.

cards.name: The Ethereum
cards.subtitle: World Computer

abilities.name: Deploy Contract
abilities.text: Turns an idea into unstoppable code in one transaction.

abilities.name: Fertile Ground
abilities.text: Every mania of the last decade sprouted from its soil.

abilities.name: The Merge
abilities.text: Reinvents its own foundations mid-flight, without stopping.

cards.weakness: A simple transfer, priced like a luxury.
cards.lore: It looked at the chronicle and asked why the book couldn't also think. From that question grew exchanges without buildings, art without frames, banks without bankers. Half the market lives on its land and complains about the rent.

traits.label: World Engine
traits.text: Runs code no one can stop.

traits.label: Endless Frontier
traits.text: Whatever is next gets built here first.

traits.label: Toll Road
traits.text: Every action pays the network.

traits.label: Shapeshifter
traits.text: Rewrites itself while running.

cards.flavor: Code is the landlord now.

cards.name: The Final Block
cards.subtitle: When the Last Bitcoin Falls

abilities.name: Count Down
abilities.text: Every block mined brings it one closer. Nothing slows it.

abilities.name: Distant Thunder
abilities.text: Felt in every halving, a century in advance.

abilities.name: The Last Coin
abilities.text: The final fraction is mined and the mint closes forever.

cards.weakness: None. It is the only certainty in the market.
cards.lore: Somewhere past the year 2140, a miner will seal the last fraction of the last coin. No one reading this card will see it. The whole experiment points at that block the way a cathedral points at heaven. It is already scheduled.

traits.label: Scheduled End
traits.text: The only deadline that cannot slip.

traits.label: Century Away
traits.text: Promised to generations unborn.

traits.label: Zero Issuance
traits.text: After it, only fees remain.

traits.label: North Star
traits.text: Every cycle steers by it.

cards.flavor: The end was written in the beginning.

cards.name: The Crypto King
cards.subtitle: Survivor of Every Cycle

abilities.name: Crown of Cycles
abilities.text: Claims a share of every boom and every ruin.

abilities.name: Seen It All
abilities.text: Immune to euphoria, panic and everything between.

abilities.name: Outlive Them All
abilities.text: When the last rival capitulates, inherits the entire board.

cards.weakness: There is no one left to share the view.
cards.lore: He bought the tops and the bottoms, was liquidated twice, rugged three times, and declared dead with every winter. He is still here. The crown is not gold; it is scar tissue. Every cycle ends with him on the throne.

traits.label: Cycle Proof
traits.text: Four winters, four springs, one king.

traits.label: Scar Crown
traits.text: Every loss became armor.

traits.label: Last Standing
traits.text: Outlasted every rival and every trend.

traits.label: Full Circle
traits.text: Ends where the Genesis began.

cards.flavor: Survive long enough and they call you king.
